description: This file defines a scraper class 'DagelijkseKost' for extracting recipe instructions from a specific website, including functions for JSON extraction, instruction parsing, and a Levenshtein distance implementation.

classes.name: DagelijkseKost
classes.description: A scraper class inheriting from AbstractScraper, tailored for the 'dagelijksekost.vrt.be' website, with methods to retrieve canonical URL and instructions.

methods.name: canonical_url
methods.description: Returns the canonical URL from schema data if available, otherwise defaults to self.url.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and returns recipe instructions by parsing embedded JSON in script tags and comparing with a short instructions string, using Levenshtein distance for fuzzy matching.
